- Updated & spacious apartments
- Superintendent on site (who is AWESOME!)
- Ample off street parking
- Water & AC/heat included
- Competitive price for the area and amenities offered
- Friendly & helpful leasing/office staff
- Online rent payment & maintenance requests
- Monthly community events
- In-Building laundry rooms (on every other floor, kind of pricey, uses a card to pay instead of coins)
- Well kept and clean common areas and building grounds

Cons:
- Outdated common areas
- No gym
- No package room
- Outdated/dysfunctional locks on main doors
- Unable to directly control thermostat temperate (basically, you choose on/off and the temperate is set for the entire building based on the season)

Overall, I had a great experience here! I didn't have a maintenance issue my entire year. The superintendent is awesome and truly cares about the building and residents. While there are some cons, none of them are major issues, so for me, the pros highly outweigh the cons. I would strongly recommend the apartment to anyone who is looking for an apartment in Hamden!

(Note: The attached pictures are from my move out inspection)

response.body: Dante, Thank you so much for taking the time to outline your year long experience at Whitney Towers. We are thrilled to hear your comments about the live-in superintendent, Rich.
